7.3.3.5.5.6 Operations – Terminate execution of an operation
[SWS_DM_01392] Support of
SOVD
method
Terminate execution of an
Operation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
For each
DiagnosticSovdOperationStop
, the
Diagnostic Server in-
stance
shall provide the SOVD method
Terminate execution of an Opera-
tion
according to ASAM SOVD[5][14].
⌋
[SWS_DM_01391]
SOVD
method
Terminate execution of an Operation
–
proximity_response
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
The
proximity_response
in the request body of SOVD method
Terminate the
Execution of an Operation
shall be validated using
ara::diag::SovdProx-
imityChallenge::ValidateResponse
.
⌋
[SWS_DM_02179] Operation
terminate execution
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If a SOVD method to terminated an operation is received and, if needed, the
proxim-
ity_challenge validation
according to [SWS_DM_02173] succeeded, the DM
shall call
ara::diag::SovdOperationExecution::Terminate
of the
SovdOp-
erationExecution
assigned to the
execution-id
[SWS_DM_02177] of the re-
quest body.
Terminating an
SovdOperationExecution
will discard the
SovdOperationExe-
cution
instance and further method calls on the
execution-id
are no longer pos-
sible and the result of such a call is
undefined
.
⌋
